_comment: TTTR LUT Tools, native emtk window. Drawn by emtk.view_form over LutToolModel (gui/model.py). Panels: 'header' (flow hint, Add all channels, Apply, Help, Guide, tab choice), 'files' (input files), 'compute' (tab 1: Compute LUT), 'assign' (tab 2: settings.tttr.json), 'status' (last message). The two plots are drawn by gui/app.py (a spec cannot draw a plot).
title: TTTR LUT Tools

sections.name: header
sections.title: LUT flow
sections.description: What the two tabs are for, the one-click bridge to the detector setup, and Help.
The normal workflow: load a flat-light file, then Add all channels to setup. Saving a settings file is optional.
Add every channel's LUT to the setup, apply it, open the help or the guided tour.

buttons.label: Add all channels to setup
buttons.description: Compute a LUT for EVERY routing channel in the loaded file (one per channel: TAC non-linearity is per channel) and assign them all to your detector setup. This is the normal way to use LUTs. Saving a .npy LUT or a settings.tttr.json is optional.

buttons.label: Apply to detector setup
buttons.description: Send the assigned LUTs and shifts to the detector setup that opened this tool.

buttons.label: Help
buttons.description: What do the two tabs do? Read the LUT workflow and the scientific notes.

buttons.label: Guide
buttons.description: A short guided tour: load a file, pick the plateau, add all channels.

sections.description: Compute LUT: MAKE a per-routing-channel LUT from a flat / uniform-illumination measurement (the main tool). settings.tttr.json: OPTIONAL, save or load a portable settings file, or assign LUT files to channels by hand.

sections.name: files
sections.title: Files
sections.description: The photon files the shown tab works on.

sections.title: Uniform-illumination TTTR file(s)
sections.description: The input files. Select a row and press Remove (or Delete) to unload it. Files can also be dropped on the window.

columns.title: File
columns.tooltip: File name; hover a row for the full path.

sections.description: Add or remove input files.

buttons.label: Files
buttons.description: Load uniform-illumination (or, on the settings tab, preview) TTTR files.

buttons.label: Folder
buttons.description: Load supported photon files recursively from a folder.

buttons.label: Database
buttons.description: Select photon files from the MMFDB object store.

buttons.label: Remove
buttons.description: Unload the selected input file.

buttons.label: Clear
buttons.description: Unload all input files; assigned LUTs are kept.

sections.name: compute
sections.title: Compute LUT
sections.description: Tab 1: tune one channel's region, then add all channels.

sections.label: Preview channel
sections.description: Preview / tune THIS routing channel's histogram and region. Add all channels to setup computes and assigns a LUT for ALL channels.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.description: The linear plateau and the size of the corrected axis.

sections.label: Linear start
sections.description: First bin of the flat linear region (or drag the orange region in the plot).

sections.label: Linear stop
sections.description: First bin after the flat linear region.

sections.label: TAC channels required
sections.description: Target number of corrected NTAC bins (defaults to the input bin count).

sections.label: Noffset
sections.description: Offset subtracted from corrected NTAC indices (or drag the red line).

sections.label: Preview photons
sections.description: How many photons to use for the corrected-preview histogram.

sections.label: Normalize by region mean
sections.description: Divide the displayed histogram by the region mean (display only).

sections.title: Advanced
sections.description: Rarely needed: seed, low-count threshold, wrap-spike mitigation.

sections.label: RNG seed
sections.description: Seed for the stochastic rebinning (reproducible previews).

sections.label: Low-count threshold
sections.description: Bins at or below this count are zeroed before building the LUT (or drag the green line).

sections.label: Mitigate wrap spike (floor + ε)
sections.description: Use floor rounding + a small epsilon to avoid a spike at the wrap boundary.

sections.label: ε (wrap)
sections.description: Epsilon used when 'Mitigate wrap spike' is on.
Find the plateau, then optionally save the LUT or the corrected micro-times.

buttons.label: Auto-detect region
buttons.description: Auto-detect the flat linear plateau of the shown channel's histogram.

buttons.label: Save LUT file...
buttons.description: Optional: save this channel's LUT to a file (JSON, NumPy, CSV or text). Not needed: use Add all channels to setup for the normal workflow.

buttons.label: Export corrected...
buttons.description: Optional: export the corrected micro-times of all photons of the shown channel.

sections.description: The LUT of the shown channel: region, width, scale factor f and the mean count n_mean.

sections.name: assign
sections.title: settings.tttr.json
sections.description: Tab 2 (optional): assign LUT files to channels and save or load settings.tttr.json.

sections.label: Reading routine
sections.description: Select the TTTR container format; Auto detects it from the file.
Import a LUT file, or clear every LUT.

buttons.label: Load LUT
buttons.description: Import a cumulative LUT from JSON, NumPy, CSV or text.

buttons.label: Remove LUT
buttons.description: Remove the selected LUT from the import list; channel assignments are kept.

buttons.label: Clear LUTs
buttons.description: Remove all loaded and assigned LUTs; shifts are kept.

sections.title: Loaded LUTs

columns.title: LUT

buttons.label: All
buttons.description: Assign the selected LUT to every routing channel in the preview.

sections.label: Show LUT panel
sections.description: Inspect the active channel's cumulative LUT and bin increments.

sections.label: Log counts
sections.description: Use a logarithmic histogram count axis.

sections.title: Channels
sections.description: The routing channels of the preview files. Tick Show to draw a channel; select a row to make it active.

columns.title: Show
columns.tooltip: Draw this channel's histograms in the plot.

columns.title: LUT
columns.tooltip: Whether a LUT is assigned to this channel.

sections.label: Shift
sections.description: Photon-level shift of the active channel after LUT correction.

buttons.label: Load JSON
buttons.description: Restore per-channel LUTs, shifts and the reading routine from a settings.tttr.json.

buttons.label: Save JSON
buttons.description: Save the portable TTTR correction settings.
